Subject: Resale certificate + tax credit request for Prairie Supply

Hi Kelly,

Thanks again for the time on our call earlier. To get Prairie set up as tax-exempt for future orders and to apply exemption to the two outstanding invoices (INV-13321, INV-13348), our finance team needs a valid resale/certificate of exemption on file. Can you please provide the resale certificate for Missouri (or the state where Prairie is registered) that meets the following minimum acceptance criteria: 

- Purchaser name exactly as it appears on the account: "Prairie Supply, Inc."
- State of issuance and state registration/tax ID (for MO this is the sales tax registration number)
- Clear statement that the purchase is for resale and the applicable statute (if available)
- Signature and date (electronic signature is acceptable)

If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign power form to capture the same info — I can send that link. Once Finance confirms the certificate, they'll apply the exemption to the two invoices and issue credit memos where applicable.

Appreciate a scan or PDF attachment. If anything is missing I’ll follow up with a short checklist.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa / Monica —

Thanks for forwarding. Quick internal checklist from Finance/TX team to confirm acceptance:

1) Purchaser name must exactly match customer record (Prairie Supply, Inc.).
2) Certificate must include purchaser tax ID or state registration number (we need the number for our audit trail).
3) Explicit reason/type: "Resale" or equivalent statement.
4) Signature and signature date (electronic signatures ok) and name/title of signatory.
5) State of issuance must be clear (MO in this case).

If #2 is missing we can't apply a credit — we'll need a re-signed copy. If the certificate is all good, Finance will:
- Apply tax-exemption flag to the account for future invoices
- Create credit memos to refund sales tax collected on INV-13321 and INV-13348 (estimate credits will post within 5 business days of acceptance)

Vanessa — can you confirm whether the attached PDF includes the state registration number? If not, ask Kelly to re-send with that field. Monica, please stand by to process credits once we get confirmation.

Thanks,
Rafael
